title: Cross-Hand Latent Representation for Vision-Language-Action Models
authors: Guangqi Jiang, Yutong Liang, Jianglong Ye, Jia-Yang Huang, Changwei Jing, Rocky Duan, Pieter Abbeel, Xiaolong Wang, Xueyan Zou

tldr.zh: XL-VLA 先通过关节重建与跨手指尖几何约束学习各手共享的潜在动作空间，再冻结手型编解码器，用多手示范训练同一个 VLA 预测潜在动作，并由目标手解码执行，实现跨手数据复用与未见手—任务组合迁移。
tldr.en: XL-VLA learns a shared latent action space through joint reconstruction and cross-hand fingertip geometry constraints, freezes hand-specific encoders/decoders, and trains one VLA on pooled multi-hand demonstrations to predict latent actions decoded for the target hand, enabling data reuse and transfer to unseen hand–task combinations.

evaluation_scope.zh: 潜在自编码器用各手关节限位内随机采样的姿态训练，结合重建、可微正运动学的跨手捏合距离／方向对齐及 KL 正则，无需成对跨手示范。π₀ 基础上的 VLA 输入图像、语言及潜在动作历史；手型仅选择编解码器，不作为显式 VLA token。真机覆盖 Ability、Inspire、X-Hand1、Paxini DexH13 四种手、10 项任务，共 2,000 条遥操作示范（约 200 万状态—动作对），并报告双 xArm 与 G1 混合训练。“零样本”评测留出部分手—任务组合，不等于任意全新手无需适配。官方 DexLatent 仓库公开潜在表示训练／推理代码与预训练检查点，不能据此认定完整 VLA 策略权重已开放。
evaluation_scope.en: The latent autoencoder uses randomly sampled joint-limit poses with reconstruction, differentiable-FK pinch-distance/direction alignment and KL regularization; paired cross-hand demonstrations are unnecessary. The π₀-based VLA consumes images, language and latent action history; hand identity selects codecs rather than an explicit VLA token. Hardware covers Ability, Inspire, X-Hand1 and Paxini DexH13 across 10 tasks and 2,000 teleoperated demonstrations (~2M state–action pairs), with additional dual-xArm/G1 co-training. Zero-shot tests hold out hand–task combinations, not arbitrary unseen hands without adaptation. The official DexLatent repository releases latent-representation training/inference code and a pretrained checkpoint; this does not establish release of full VLA policy weights.
